title: 第3章 渡成仙劫踏入地仙境第4章 天剑化虹无量剑胎
slug: 西游开局获得太白金星传承
lines: 倏尔，这三道身影似有感应，齐齐望向了下界。
眸光穿透无尽虚空，看到了身在黄风岭的叶云。
那慈眉善目的老人轻甩浮尘，仙风道骨。
“有意思，没想到我等留在下界道统里的道图，里面的太白剑经，竟然被一虎妖领悟。”
看起来不食人间烟火，如高高在上神祇的青年，也是啧啧称奇。
“这虎妖竟有如此资质，难得，难得。”
最后是那位浑身杀伐之气冲天的女子，她一开口，杀气就如同找到了宣泄口一样，瞬间弥漫了整座大殿。
“且看他修行的如何，如果能够有所成，也不算辱没我等创造的这法门。”
这三道身影的身份已然呼之欲出了。
正是太白金星的本尊和两大化身。
本尊是手拿拂尘的老者形象，而两大化身，青年为金星星君之相，女子，则是主杀伐的女杀神之相。
而造成这样原因，一方面是因为所修功法的缘故。
另一方面也是当初天庭初立，人手严重不足，他作为玉帝的小棉袄，自然是要为其分忧。
所以，种种因素的加持下，才造就了三个太白金星。
不过随着天庭在三界六道之中站稳跟脚，可用的仙神增多。
渐渐的，太白金星只以本尊出现，两大化身便一直坐镇金星星宫之中。
久而久之，世人也就只记得太白金星一副和蔼可亲的老人形象。
忘却了，天庭初立之时，这位大佬杀性最重，手段最烈。
此时。
太白金星本尊和两大化身，各自收回目光，不再关注叶云。
毕竟只是初得他们留下的法门，想要真正有所成，还有很长一条路需要走。
在那之前，还不值得他们投下过多关注。
黄风岭。
叶云收起道图，随即去了这四妖在附近建立的洞府。
在里面找到了一些兵器，除此之外，就是各种残骸。
有妖的，也有人的。
显然是这四妖抓来作为资粮的。
叶云摇了摇头，原本还指望这四个外来的家伙，还有些存货。
没想到，也是穷的一批。
不过能得到道图，学会了太白剑经，已经是天大的机缘了。
毕竟，如果靠着他血脉传承里的功法，撑死也就达到地仙初期层次。
content_en:
Suddenly, these three figures seemed to be sensing something, and they all looked towards the lower world.
His eyes penetrated the endless void and saw Ye Yun in Huangfengling.
The old man with kind eyebrows and kind eyes flicked away the floating dust, showing his immortal demeanor.
"It's interesting. I didn't expect that the Taibai Sword Sutra in the Taoist map we left in the lower realm would be understood by a tiger demon."
The young man who looked like a god above the world was also astonished.
"It's rare that this tiger demon has such qualifications."
Finally, there was the woman who was filled with murderous aura. As soon as she opened her mouth, her murderous aura filled the whole hall instantly as if she had found an outlet.
"Let's see how well he practices. If he can achieve something, it won't be a disgrace to the method we created."
The identities of these three figures are already evident.
It is the true form and two incarnations of Taibai Jinxing.
The original image is an old man holding a fly whisk in his hand, and the two incarnations are the young man in the form of the King of Venus and the woman in the form of the murderous goddess.
The reason for this is, on the one hand, because of the exercises practiced.
On the other hand, when the Heavenly Court was first established, there was a serious shortage of manpower. As the Jade Emperor's little cotton-padded jacket, he naturally had to share his worries.
Therefore, with the blessing of various factors, three Taibaijin stars were created.
However, as Heaven has gained a firm foothold in the Three Realms and Six Paths, the number of available immortals has increased.
Gradually, Taibai Venus only appeared in its true form, and the two incarnations have been sitting in the Venus Palace.
Over time, the world only remembered the image of Taibai Jinxing as an amiable old man.
I have forgotten that when Heaven was first established, this boss was the most murderous and the most violent.
at this time.
Taibai Jinxing's original form and the two incarnations each withdrew their gaze and no longer paid attention to Ye Yun.
After all, I have just begun to learn the techniques they left behind. If I want to truly achieve something, I still have a long way to go.
Until then, it's not worthy of their attention.
…
Huangfengling.
Ye Yun put away the Tao map and immediately went to the cave built nearby by the four demons.
Some weapons were found inside, but other than that, there were all kinds of wreckage.
There are demons and humans.
It was obvious that these four demons had captured him as a resource.
Ye Yun shook his head. He originally hoped that these four outsiders would still have some stocks.
Unexpectedly, they are also a poor group.
However, it was a great opportunity to obtain the Dao Map and learn the Taibai Sword Sutra.
After all, if he relied on the skills inherited from his bloodline, he would have reached the early stage of Earth Immortal even if he survived.
